description: This file defines the interface CapitalizedIncomeBalanceService within the loan account service of the Fineract project. It declares methods for calculating capitalized income and its adjustment for a given loan.

classes.name: CapitalizedIncomeBalanceService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for calculating capitalized income and its adjustments for loans.

methods.name: calculateCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Calculates the capitalized income for a given loan.

methods.name: calculateCapitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates the adjustment to the capitalized income for a given loan.
